sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time
import re

def events(path):
    t=open(path).read()
    out=[]
    for b in re.findall(r'BEGIN:VEVENT(.*?)END:VEVENT',t,re.S):
        s=re.search(r'DTSTART:(\S+)',b).group(1)
        e=re.search(r'DTEND:(\S+)',b).group(1)
        out.append((datetime.strptime(s,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),datetime.strptime(e,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')))
    return out

alice=events('/workspace/alice_calendar.ics')
bob=events('/workspace/bob_calendar.ics')
carol=events('/workspace/carol_calendar.ics')

def busy(ev,s,e): return any(s < be and e > bs for bs,be in ev)

def valid_day(d):
    # hard availability windows
    # Alice 09:00-14:00, Bob 10:00-18:00 (16:30 Tue/Thu), Carol 09:00-17:00
    al_s,al_e=datetime.combine(d,time(9)),datetime.combine(d,time(14))
    bob_end=time(16,30) if d.weekday() in (1,3) else time(18)
    bo_s,bo_e=datetime.combine(d,time(10)),datetime.combine(d,bob_end)
    ca_s,ca_e=datetime.combine(d,time(9)),datetime.combine(d,time(17))
    t=max(al_s,bo_s,ca_s)
    end=min(al_e,bo_e,ca_e)
    while t+timedelta(hours=1)<=end:
        s=t;e=t+timedelta(hours=1)
        lunch = s < datetime.combine(d,time(12,30)) and e > datetime.combine(d,time(12))
        ok = not busy(alice,s,e) and not busy(bob,s,e) and not busy(carol,s,e) and not lunch
        if ok:
            yield s,e
        t+=timedelta(minutes=1)

start=datetime(2024,1,15)
for i in range(5):
    d=start+timedelta(days=i)
    slots=list(valid_day(d))
    print(d.strftime('%a %Y-%m-%d'), 'first valid:', slots[0] if slots else None, 'count:',len(slots))
PY
EOF
